title: WetBulbInput
description: Input to the Stull (2011) wet-bulb temperature formula.

tempC.description: Dry-bulb air temperature in degrees Celsius. Stull (2011) is validated for [-20, 50].

rhPercent.description: Relative humidity in percent. Stull (2011) is validated for [5, 99]; implementations MUST clamp inputs to [5, 100] and report a clamped value as clampedRhPct. RH in (99, 100] is computed as given, since 100 % is a real humidity.
